English: Canvas Shelter
Rough tents and makeshift awnings, providing the barest shelter from desert winds and sun.
Mudbrick Hut
Simple, sun-baked mudbrick dwellings and storage pits offer basic protection against sand and heat.
Windbreak Wall
Low mudbrick walls and windbreaks shield dwellings from blowing sand, making life more tolerable and defensible.
Well House
A guarded well and water storage system, vital for survival and sustaining larger garrisons on the frontier.
Stone Shelter
A rudimentary stone barracks and ramparts, providing a stronghold for desert patrols and a base for further expansion.
Shaded Compound
A perimeter of walls and shade structures, supporting a small permanent garrison and improved living conditions.
Sandstone Outpost
A substantial outpost with sandstone towers, watch platforms, and reinforced walls to command vast desert approaches.
Fortified Camp
A walled camp with reinforced gates, barracks, and archery platforms, supporting a sizable, disciplined garrison.
Oasis Compound
A large, self-sustaining stronghold, with high walls, bastions, and dedicated quarters for retainers and knights, clustered around a life-giving oasis.
Desert Fortress
A grand citadel of stone, with towering walls, multiple gates, and advanced defenses, able to anchor rule over the harsh desert and command vital trade routes.
